Greetings, Agents. 
 
This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.
​
We will guide you through the 11/15 Update 
that will be released for MARVEL Future Fight.
 
Further announcement will be made through this notice
once the update has been completed and is available for download.
Please check the details below.

 

[11/16 (Wed) 5:06 (UTC+0), 11/15 (Tue) 21:06 (PST) added]
The update has been completed.
Please download the update through the link below.
​▶ Go to the [Google Play Store] to update MARVEL Future Fight
▶ Go to the  [Apple App Store] to update MARVEL Future Fight
 
■ 11/15 Update Details
 
1. The critical damage % effect of the Mighty / Brilliant C.T.P. of Rage <Enraged> 
has been improved to be effective against enemies with high defenses as well.
 
The MARVEL Future Fight team will do our best for a better service.
 
Thank you.
